speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Can I get more clarity on what the operating costs that were lower than expected were?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: It is an operation, as the Member will know, so there are many different things that could happen.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: But actually, in total, it partially also offsets increases.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, there will be some decreases, some increases and largely because there are operational demands within the public healthcare institution.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: Is it due to things like lower take-up rate of salary enhancement schemes or is it because of other aspects that might have led to longer waiting times for patients?

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: Because we would have expected that because of an ageing population, operating costs should have gone up and if anything, it would have exceeded the expectations and the budgeted amounts rather than decrease.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: So, is patient care compromise in any way because of this?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I can appreciate the Member's concern, Mr Speaker.
